snippet.title: Backyard Baseball - Coming July 2026
snippet.description:
Get your first look at how the new Backyard Baseball will open when it launches this summer. This opening title sequence blends classic 2D animation with a modern 3D reveal, paying homage to the original games as we level up into a new era! 

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3935020/Backyard_Baseball/

Check backyardbaseball.com for the latest info on console availability. Yes, CONSOLES!

More details and updates coming soon. 

Follow us on social media!
